commit.message:
[trainer, ops, model] chore: regenerate deepseek_v3 diffs via check_patchgen --fix

``make patchgen`` (which calls ``run_codegen --all --diff``) and CI's
``check_patchgen --fix`` produce diffs with slightly different hunk
granularity — same content, different chunk boundaries — and CI flags
the latter as the source of truth. Regenerate the deepseek_v3 GPU/NPU
``.diff`` artifacts so the patchgen-drift gate passes.
